notes.title: Development Blog: New Map (Taiga)
notes.content:
It has been a while from a pretty regular update, here is. Introducing Taiga, the all brand new Frontline Map supports from 16 to 24 Players.

[h1]Map Preview[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014481/b83050d735fb37d6ef5b595e40d6ee6359516714.png[/img]

[h3]Keypoints[/h3]
[list]
[*] Less Linear
[*] First Vertical map experience
[*] Total of 5 Objectives
[/list]

We're looking for the community feedbacks on the map experience, make sure to join the discord to play together or reporting feedback
